title: events.subscribe
description: Subscribes the connection to events for every pane in the session, as pane.list sees them, and to pane.output for the caller's own pane only; other panes' output, its children's included, is never sent, and asking for it is no error, but a caller outside any pane that asks for pane.output is refused. Needs hello version 2 and a caller with a controlling terminal. One subscription per connection; a second is refused. After the result the core sends notifications, {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "event", "params": <event>}, with no id. A subscriber that lets 2 MiB of them queue unread is closed.

event.description: The params of a notification: pane numbers, status, its source and exit status only, never screen contents, titles or messages, except the text of pane.output.

status.description: Not with pane.closed or pane.output. As pane.list reports it.

source.description: Not with pane.closed or pane.output. As pane.list reports it: marks, which output can fake, or a pane.status report.

exit.description: Not with pane.closed or pane.output. The last exit status the shell gave, or null.

text.description: With pane.output only: what the pane printed, as plain text without escape sequences, at most 4096 bytes an event. Only for the caller's own pane, as it is printed.
